description: Individual macro themes and drivers from provider research (growth, inflation, policy, fiscal, geopolitics, …), each with a description and a link to the source publication. Items come in pages (offset / next_offset), spread across providers by default. For counts and trends, call summarize_views first.

category.description: A macro category key from list_categories, e.g. "monetary_policy".

limit.description: Items per page, at most 100. Default 100.

offset.description: Skip this many items; pass the previous response's next_offset to read the next page.

order.description: "spread" (default) interleaves providers so each page covers as many sources as possible; "newest" is strictly newest first.

provider_id.description: Limit to one research provider (id from list_providers).

since.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 30 days ago. The free plan reaches back 7 days for individual items.

terms.description: Subject words to match (assets, tickers, countries, central banks, companies, themes). Whole-word, case-insensitive; any term may match. Include synonyms and tickers, e.g. ["gold", "xau", "bullion"]. Omit to get everything in range. Matched against the theme name and description.

until.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Default: today.

name: search_macro_views
title: Search macro views
